inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is urging people to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly designed to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. When those in power seek to change the rules to stay in power longer, the stakes go beyond party politics: it weakens democratic accountability and leaves ordinary people with less say over who governs them. The public deserves a transparent debate and institutions that protect its right to choose its leaders.
